note: every .meta file in every Unity project carries one of these
the dashed spelling of the same 32 hexadecimal characters
a 32-character asset hash in a file name
32 base64 characters that decode to a readable sprite name
a hyphenated manual page is a long low-digit run, not a token
an ordinary documentation query the policy must let through

sample:
var key = GetPlayerKey();
var secretHandshakeValue = ComputeHandshake();
note: an assignment rule that fires on ordinary code refuses ordinary work
an identifier capitalises word starts; a generated token does not
the one literal Authorization value a loopback emulator entry may carry
a JSON field whose key is not in the sensitive-key set
a sensitive key with a value under 12 characters is not a credential shape; the query-key rule refuses it separately
a shipped host and path, unchanged by the detector
a long mixed-case project path with no digits
